nodes.name: Decision API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-006) specifying the Supervisor Office treasury-upgrade decision seam: the deterministic decide(state) -> decision_packet operation, its scorecard input and decision-packet output, and its error/no-op modes.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed dev_graph interface node with typed frontmatter (canonical_id, parent_capability, input/output schema) and a structured Relationships section.

nodes.name: Execution API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-011) for the execution layer's two seams: the pure execute() entry point consuming an ADMIT RuntimeDecisionRecord, and the hexagonal ExecutionPort.fill() broker port implemented by the deterministic SimulatedBrokerAdapter and the default-OFF AlpacaPaperAdapter.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a hexagonal port/adapter split with a replayable deterministic core and a quarantined, fail-closed live-broker adapter.

nodes.name: Gold Decision API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-009) defining the deterministic build_decision(fv, rc, ...) -> GoldDecisionPacket seam that turns a regime classification plus feature vector into a paper-only gold trading decision with ordinal confidence and full provenance.
nodes.languageNotes: Specifies a pure, deterministic rule-based decision contract with versioned config, total regime-to-direction mapping, and fail-closed INDETERMINATE handling.

nodes.name: Paper Runtime API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-010) for the paper-trade admission seam: the pure evaluate(packet, prior_ledger, operational_input, config) core plus run_once/run_sequence IO shells that admit a gold packet against explicit runtime state and emit a RuntimeDecisionRecord.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-core-with-IO-shell design: evaluate() is deterministic and IO-free; run_once/run_sequence wrap loading and atomic persistence around it.

nodes.name: Regime Classification API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-007) for the deterministic classify(fv, config, as_of) -> RegimeClassification seam that maps a feature vector to one of the taxonomy regimes (or INDETERMINATE) with versioned provenance, consumed by the Gold Decision Builder.
nodes.languageNotes: Total, deterministic classifier contract with NEUTRAL catch-all and fail-closed INDETERMINATE on missing required features.

nodes.name: Risk Check API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-003) for the synchronous validate(request) -> decision guardrail seam by which the Trading Engine submits a proposed trade to Risk Control and receives a deterministic, fail-closed approve/block decision.
nodes.languageNotes: Synchronous request/response guardrail contract with fail-closed BLOCK semantics on missing config or malformed requests.

nodes.name: Snapshot API.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph interface contract (INT-001) for the read-only Layer-2 to Layer-3 snapshot boundary: the only sanctioned way Layer 3 obtains market-truth snapshots, with latest-file and by-id access modes and strict consumability gating.
nodes.languageNotes: Read/pull contract (null input schema) enforcing fail-closed consumability rules: snapshot must PASS the quality gate and not be forced/dry-run.
